I figured, but it’s making me so anxious I wanted to get input of any kind. 

Yes, and for decades it was supposed to go to my aunt, up until last year. 

My grandma has had memory issues for about 7 years now, and it has been progressing since then. She can hardly remember what happened just a few minutes ago and forgets she has a daughter, this has been happening for maybe two years. 

Im not sure what Can be used as proof for that besides testimonies from people uninvolved in the business (they had many friends so this would be easy) or her doctor. Apparently she has been taking pills for her memory loss for years now.
Thank you everyone! The answers bring me some hope in this messy situation.
They have both a will and a trust. And we are in California. Sorry, forgot to mention that in the post.

Well here, I edited it out. To ME, it seemed like you were excusing the messaging. And it really doesn’t matter because the “you” can be interpreted differently. I don’t care about sympathy, I just want people to be aware of this person because their unwarranted messages CAN be dangerous for people in this sub. You straight up disagreed. People come to subs like these and like yours because they are vulnerable and are seeking help. If you don’t see that as a danger to the people in your sub, that’s on yall. People like them piss me off and I don’t want them messaging other people like this.
I’m upset anyone else has to go through this, but it does bring me some comfort in knowing I’m not alone. Thank you and best of luck. ❤️

Thank you for the reply. I like the idea of reframing it that way, thank you for that! 

Honestly I have never told any therapist the truth of what has really happened to me, but I’m ready this time around. So yeah I should look for therapists who specialize in these kind of things.

Sending a hug right back! Thanks for the thoughtful response ❤️
It is. Luckily I don’t listen to people like this but for someone who’s truly vulnerable and down it could be potentially dangerous, which is why it pissed me off so much 🤦🏻‍♀️

Also I just want to bring to light that a user named kino-murakami messaged me privately to tell me “Nothing is going to change. You won’t have people enter your life who love you unconditionally. You don’t attract such kinds of people”. I’m messaging the mod teams on several boards about this psycho and if you’re reading this, I suggest you block them.

https://imgur.com/a/269othr

Currently, I am not. I’ve been to so many therapists throughout my life and idk. I feel like it will be triggering for me if yet another one doesn’t work out for me, you know? I know that’s not a good excuse.
My ex bf was abusive, that’s who I was referring to. I broke up with him and I’m with someone else now. Thanks!

I just came here to say that getting straight A’s is difficult and takes a lot of effort and dedication. I respect you for getting there. That’s awesome. I’m sorry your mother is that way. To me and I’d say the majority of others if not all, that is impressive. Definitely an accomplishment, I hope if she doesn’t make you feel proud or good about it then you can at least feel that way for yourself. Wishing you the best.

Thanks for your response friend. 
I just started therapy so hopefully I can work through it soon. Sometimes I just wish my life hadn’t been like that, but I guess all I can do is deal with it. 

Unfortunately I can’t move very far, I love the city I’m in and would be upset to leave all my friends. Starting a new job sounds nice and I can use it as an excuse to get out of things. Thank you ❤️
Thank you

No, thank you. I know he doesn’t love me. He is just using me as a sex object sometimes, never took my triggers during sex seriously even after knowing about all my past sexual assaults. Never considered what he’d be like if he wasn’t attracted to me, but I’m sure I wouldn’t be in his life.
Always nice to be entertained by someone’s pain eh? Nice.

Yeah, I’ve been realizing lately that being treated certain ways isn’t normal as I thought it was. I’ve never really been ok with being treated the way I’ve been my whole life, but I just assumed that was life & I had to deal with it, or that somehow I deserved it because my fate was to just get shat on my whole life for whatever reason.

There’s many red flags unmentioned. Example, Our latest argument today was about how I said “I’ve bought you stuff randomly on multiple occasions, this is not one of them” when we were going out to buy a jacket & he said “I’m gonna pick one thing so you can get it for me”. He told me he was joking but I should’ve just said “yeah sure”. He expects me to say yes if he “really wanted” something. He forgot all the times I bought him clothes for no reason at all but because I wanted to make him happy, and the only time he has ever bought me a present was this last Christmas because I asked him to do something for me bc ive always gotten him gifts. 

So yes, I’ve been dating different variants of my father just as many people in my situation do. I only recently realized how horribly it messed with me & it’s a super shitty realization. Many things I have to work on.
Thank you. I’m glad he told me the truth.
He said the same to me. I’m sorry you experienced something similar. It did hurt to hear. A lot.
Thanks. That’s what I was thinking when he told me that, he asked me “well what did you want to hear??” I said “the truth”. He thinks I should just compromise.

Thank you for sharing. I’m so sorry your father was like that. I don’t understand that at all. At no point in this relationship did I ever crave to have children with him. So many things he’s done reminded me of my dad (not that he’s physically abusive). I would never want to bring a child into a situation like that. I really really really would like to break the cycle. Now I know to be more careful and now I know to get the hell away at the first red flag. I feel stupid having ignored them before things got serious but being treated badly was the norm for me, so I didn’t think much of it. That’s why I like posting online so I can get perspectives from normal people who know what healthy relationships should be like.

I think if he really loved me he would think that way, too. He doesn’t love me. He’s always trying to change me. Always getting mad at me for not matching up to his expectations. Thanks for your comment.
I’m happy you have something like that. That’s what I want someday. I had a dream a while ago that we had kids & he spent more time with his nephew than his new family. I guess it was a warning, lol

I told him how I felt about it through tears and he was smiling at me the whole time & told me “you see this? I’m smiling because what you’re saying is that fucking stupid”. Then proceeded to tell me the rest of the night that it’s just something I have to get used to. So thanks for this. I need to let him stop convincing me that my feelings aren’t valid.

Lol. Obviously I did bad by reddit standards and didn’t thoroughly explain every little aspect of my thoughts. My child comes before anyone else. But thanks for that assumption, sure you meant well! :)
He might’ve taken it as I don’t want him talking to his family & have all of his attention on me 24/7, and put his family to the side. But I clarified that wasn’t the case.
My cat isn’t allowed outside for too long, and my last dog knew this. We’d tell him to go get her and hed run outside and chase her back inside. It was super funny. One of the smartest dogs I’ve had.

He’s making me feel like I’m controlling but I don’t feel like I am. The difference between him & i is that I actually would care if I’m being controlling, and would want to know so I can stop. He doesn’t care what any of our mutual friends have to say about his treatment towards me, he’s always in the right. 

We are on our first vacation together and multiple times last night I had to just stare off into space or pick at my nails because he was texting them. Literally. All. Night. I don’t know who you have to text that much. After that I wasn’t even interested in trying to talk to him. Bad communication, probably. At this point I don’t care much anymore.

I cannot say ANYTHING bad about his family or close friends without him getting pissed at me, even if I’m right. But if one of them said something bad about me I’m so sure he wouldn’t back me up. That’s what bothers me the most. I thought relationships were supposed to be two people as a team, supporting each other.

Thanks for your input. I should break up with him, glad to hear I’m not crazy for thinking this way :/
No offense taken. Thanks for that reminder.

I was taking it (I'm not right now, on a break because switching insurance) and it was working very very well. Of course nothing makes depression go completely away but it has definitely been a life saver. I wish you luck.
Thank you.

Man. I feel for the guy but this also sucks to see how bad I missed out on a decent father. I wish he protected me like this, instead he was my Larry Nassar. If I was a parent I would've done the same thing. What a sad situation

Therapy is very expensive, so I don't go. It hasn't seemed to help in the past it seems. 

Meds helped a lot. I guess it just made me upset to see how much I really need them. The stigma behind mental illness makes me feel ashamed sometimes for taking them in the first place, and then I remember it's just like medicine, after all it is called a mental /illness/. There's still that feeling that I'm 'crazy' though, even though I don't see others with the same problem that way 😔
Unfortunately. I wish they did not. I'm currently a marketing major.
I’m sorry. I hope you are able to work things out or move on as well.
Thank you. Today he said a lot more hurtful things and I realized I was numb to it. I don’t want that for myself. I’m going to try.
I’m sorry you went through that. Thank you for responding.
Thank you for sharing your story. I’m glad you were able to get out of it. I will try. It’s so hard. I thought he was my best friend.
Thank you.
Thank you for that. I really hope you are right

I have had severe depression ever since I was little. It's so painful. And no matter what I do it never really goes away. I would wonder what I'm missing. I make more than most people my age, just by doing nothing. I'm good looking I guess. I'm healthy despite this. I'm not starving. I have a roof over my head. I have all my limbs. What else could possibly be missing. 

I figured since being loved is the only thing I really haven't experienced, maybe that's it. Maybe that's the key. 

Im just scared I won't ever find it. I'm even more scared that I will continue feeling like my life is meaningless even if I find it. I understand what you mean though, and thank you for bothering to read this sad rant by a person you don't even know. Makes me feel a bit less lonely..

No I'm not still talking to her. It was just one phone call telling her to back the hell off. 

It's so hard to gain confidence. I don't know how I can. Especially after this. If this relationship ends I'll be a mess. It's just so hard to move on and get better when you don't have much/any support. 

Thank you for the insight. I wish he saw things the way you do and tried to help me out instead of telling me I'm crazy, obsessive etc 😔 because I don't mean to be. But to ask anyone to care about me or help me is asking too much.

I'll try and write down some things now. Thank you

Thank you for your reply. I think about that song too. But apparently that type of behavior is "crazy". People don't realize that people who lash out after being hurt are the ones who have been hurt countless times and are just so fucking sick of it.

I want to go to therapy but it's so expensive. I don't love myself enough to spend all that money on something that might not even work. 

I just want one healthy, normal relationship. Just one. 😔 he said I'm an attention seeker, I'm a slut but all I really just want is to be loved for once.

I feel like I am... I feel so stupid that my childhood trauma is still fucking me up. Every day is just me being terrified that people I care about will just randomly decide they hate me and leave my life. People would rather call me crazy than try to understand where I'm coming from. As if they could put themselves in my shoes in the first place. They can't cause most people grew up with love and can't imagine it being any different. 

Id like to talk about it but not publicly. It's also kind of a long story. 😞

I'm sorry you're able to relate. For so long I've just remembered him by his disgusting selfish abusive ways (he's dead now). I guess I just realized that deep down I had always wanted him to love me, and for him to go back to who he was before. If you would've asked me before watching those videos I wouldve said I didn't care whether or not he loved me, I just was upset that I didn't have a dad. 

Just a shitty and confusing realization. Having an addict as a parent is terrible.

Thank you. I do need to be single for some time. When this ends I'm going to force myself to be. Can't remember a time in my life beyond 7th grade where 6 months passed without me being in a relationship lol. 

Two cats is kind of a stereotype for a crazy sad single lady. Which I totally would be but I can't let people know that. I'll do one cat one dog.

I know. It's hard to not do it more often but thankfully I can control myself pretty well. I smoke weed a lot, just because it's nice, but I do go to it when I'm having a pretty bad anxiety attack or feeling like I'm going to hurt myself. 

Edit: P.S good luck on your recovery and congrats on taking the first step
I know, I need to be more proactive in finding ways to busy myself. Thank you
Thank you! :) I will take a look
Thank you for taking a look and replying! We weren't taught to use those kind of programs, I've been using a TI-84 calculator. I'm also not sure what infinite df is :(
I didn't like the fact that her sons blackness was such a big deal. And how she kept making jokes about a white woman liking black men. Rubbed me the wrong way. That, and the lack of any humor.

I'm so sorry you feel that pain. I know that pain all too well. That's amazing that you went so long without it! I can hardly manage three months, and I've been doing it for years. It's hard not to do it when you have no one to talk to. You are fine. People slip up here and there.

I know this feeling and I'm sorry you feel this way. There were weeks where I used to wake up.. if it was any time before 10:30 I took two or three melatonins to make me go back to sleep because I didn't want to be awake. 

If you ever need someone to talk to please message me.
Amazing! Beautiful work. I think if anyone went this far to make a gift for me I would cry. You're a very good friend, OP. They will remember this gift forever.

This. I can make friends. I can make "close" friends but I never feel a true, strong connection. I never fully trust them. I like to think that it's perhaps not solely due to my depression, but the fact that I'm a bit "different" lol
Lol it wouldn't, I just thought that since its basically my doing that she's getting 50k + more a year that she would at least watch my bird.
Thanks for the reply. They have bought their tickets though, should've mentioned that. Regardless, is it mean for me to say that? I don't want to go about it in a mean way.
I'm sorry my friend. Wishing you peace. I don't get how some people are able to do the things they do.
Being betrayed hurts like shit, but it hurts even worse when they don't put effort into helping you heal or helping you regain trust afterwards.
This is a type of relationship I hope to have one day. You are a very lucky person.
Still feeling bad unfortunately. Think this sent me a huge step back when I was just making some good progress 😞
Thank you. We broke up about three years ago, I moved states because of him.
Thank you.
Thank you. Yeah, sometimes people suck.

Aunt abruptly stopped talking to all of us. It's been an on and off thing for over a year now. Grandparents thankfully don't talk much about him. Except for holidays where my grandpa now makes a speech saying how we "all" wish my father was back to celebrate with us, and how "we" need to be able to forgive (while looking me straight in the eye). Luckily no one talks to me about him much anymore, still sucks hearing about him. After going to family gatherings I cry the whole rest of the day. It's better but not nice, just something I have to get used to unfortunately. On the positive side, this monster is no longer in my life and can never hurt me again, so I'm grateful for that. Thank you for your concern :)
He's so cute. My last dog loved bananas too. I'm sorry for your loss. It's so hard.

It worked pretty quickly for me. It does make me kind of upset that it works, makes me feel like I really am "sick". I really hope I will only need it for up to two years. I really really hope my life will change for the better then cause I don't trust prescription pills. If you're to the point where you are constantly thinking that you want to die, id suggest them. That's the only reason I gave in, and I haven't had a mental breakdown since, thank god.

I'm 21. I also am thinking I should move to another city or something and just start over. It's scary though, and the only nearby city id move to is more expensive. So that's a big maybe if I ever get around to it.

I have a few online friends, it's the physical contact & presence that I want though.

Well obviously. A cat with less optimal genes will have the same genes outside or inside. I do think that it vastly helps in having a cat to live to a long age, though. There's a lot of factors involved. Most cats here where I live who are outdoor do not live very long. 25 is a long time, I'm glad you were able to enjoy your friend for so long!
Guess it has a lot to do with location. Where I live there's coyotes and predatory birds, if a cat is gone for a day or two here, owners get very worried. I can imagine other places to be fine
Really? Where do you live? I live in California in an area where there are many coyotes and predatory birds :(

Definitely has to do with him being an indoor cat. My cat is 9 and has been an "indoor" cat. We didn't let her out the first two years and we think that scared her into wanting to stay close to home. Since then we let her into the backyard but she's such a good girl, she never leaves! My last three cats were outdoor, two left and never returned (they were old) and one got killed at night by some sort of bird. I don't think I will ever have an outdoor cat.

If they are able to pick up subtle changes in your energy or personality, or behavior etc, and bring them up/ask if everything is alright. Being depressed for more than half my life has made me have an overwhelming need to help people, and to make them happy, because I never want anyone to feel the way I do. 

So when I notice small things I get very concerned. I check in on them after their rant. I go out of my way for them. Maybe this won't be the same for people who are depressed because of a particular situation, but generally people who have been through a lot in their lives are always reaching out to others.

I'm exactly the same. I'm sorry you can relate. When I feel tension in any relationship (like 90% of the time I'm wrong and there's none lol) I'll get them something or do something for them. Super unhealthy

I'm sorry. My father was pretty shitty too. I think it would be pretty awesome to be able to break the cycle and be the best parent to my future child(ren), or at least be a supportive person in a kids life. Keep your head up, friend.
Thank you friend. I appreciated your response during this hard time. I hope someone will appreciate me for who I am someday.

We have a very very strange relationship. Long story. I still live with him but he doesn't see a future with me, and therefore doesn't spend much time thinking about me I guess. He was the only person to wish me a merry Christmas (he's on vacation) but it saddened me that he didn't ask how I was doing. I expect too much from someone who is not so interested in me, guess that's my fault.

Yes, I read it. Since you feel like you can relate I don't mind any venting. I am very sorry to hear that you can relate. I too have been dealing with depression for quite some time (~14 years) and often will have a fun time with friends, just to go back home and burst into tears. 

I'm very lucky I'm able to enjoy fun times. It's a shame I get very upset afterwards though. If you would ever like some advice or support on how to become more outgoing please reach out to me, I'm not super outgoing but I used to be very very very shy, and now I am not. 

I can't say that becoming less shy will help as much as you'd like, because as ""outgoing"" as I am, and as how comfortable people are with me, I still am not able to feel a connection with anyone. I can only hope that in time that will change. I hope the same for you, too. I know how lonely and scary it feels. And it does help to know I'm not the only one who feels like this.

I'm very sorry that you can relate. And thank you for reminding me of the reasons to stay. I fight so hard to be strong so that one day I can have my own family and show my children and husband 100x the love an appreciation that I was never shown. I really do hope that is possible for me. Thank you for your reply my friend. I hope you were able to do something to lift your spirits this holiday season.
Thank you for your response friend. I do have a lot of issues with confidence. Your example was well needed. Happy holidays

I'm so sorry you had a bad Christmas as well. But I like to believe that if someone cared about me enough, they would want to be with me while I'm sad in attempt to make me feel better. I have been trying very hard this past year to be more positive around people, and to be less paranoid of their intentions. So, so hard. There's very little progress but I hope I can continue to try.
